about: Template only: a file whose name starts with _ grants nothing. Real files are written by `stop-approve.sh record` (the owner's chat session or the delegator, never a build run, from the owner's own chat words in the list round), one per recording, named <YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM>.json, committed straight onto origin/main; never write or edit one by hand: every entry's digest covers the file's id, granted_at, expires_at, signed_by, recorded_by and the entry's n, ticket, category, detail and paths, so an edit voids it. Read from origin/main by stop-check.sh and pick-tickets.js. docs/archon/stop-policy.md.
expires_at: 7 days after granted_at, or the earlier --until (any time of day), as UTC; once its ticket merges the entry has nothing left to cover
signed_by: the policy's owner: whose approval it is
recorded_by: who wrote the file: chat (the owner's chat session) or delegator
words: the owner's own chat words that gave the approval, verbatim; required

entries.category: one coverable category id of policy.json: db-migration, auth-access, crypto-logging, delete-history, production-config, deploy, governance
entries.detail: exactly what is approved: the one action this entry covers
paths: optional; required for governance: the protected paths the approval covers, each a repo path or glob, never one starting with *
